summary: Iteration 13 — Daybook module verified end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_daybook.py. POST /api/daily-sales (any auth) computes cash_total from denominations, clamps negatives, ignores unknown denomination keys, admin & employees can log own entry; GET /api/daily-sales is workspace-wide with user=/from_date/to_date filters and returns display_name; PATCH is owner-OR-admin (non-owner non-admin → 403, 404 on missing); DELETE is admin-only (owner & other emp → 403). GET /api/daybook?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns {due_collection, daily_sales, grand_total} where grand_total.cash|online|total exactly equal sum of the two sections (validated with 2 daily-sales + 1 collection on same day). cascade_rename_user migrates db.daily_sales.user — rename emp7→emp7test carried an existing entry with it; reset to emp7 after test. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): (a) More→'Daybook' row visible to admin AND employee (emp3). (b) /daybook header 'Daybook', date bar with prev/today/next, giant brand-color grand-total card with cash+online chips, two collapsible sections (Daily sales, Due collection) with C/O mini pills; per-entry rows show denomination badges (500×3 etc.), cash/online chips, pencil for own row (admin has pencil on all daily-sale rows), trash only for admin on daily-sale rows (verified emp3 sees 0 delete buttons and pencil only on own row). (c) Editor sheet: 6 denomination inputs ₹500..₹10 render, live cash box updates, online input, live grand-total pill; entering 500×3 + online 500 → cash ₹1,500 + grand ₹2,000 verified in DOM. Save creates entry that immediately appears in Daily sales section as own row.

issues: Spec calls the grand-total card 'giant purple', but the implementation uses theme.color.brand which renders as the app's orange brand color (frontend/app/daybook.tsx:490). Consistent with the rest of the app; flagging only because the wording in the review request said 'purple'.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether the grand-total card should be purple (per spec wording) or keep the app brand color — currently brand orange.

backend/server.py:1575-1613 daybook aggregate sums cash/online/total for each section and returns grand_total = sum of both — matches spec exactly.
